slides.subtitle: Checking understanding
goals: Rephrase when someone doesn't understand you.

head: Function
Phrases
rows: What do you mean by…? / Could you explain that?
So you mean that…? / If I understand correctly…
What I mean is… / In other words… / Let me put it another way.
Let me think… / That's a good question.
